test_cases.title: Tier-1 env-JSON source resolves role to persona without consulting Tier-2 or Tier-3
test_cases.objective: Verify that when a role is mapped in the PERSONA_ROLE_MAP env variable, the resolver returns the persona from Tier-1 without querying the config file or Postgres.
preconditions: PERSONA_ROLE_MAP env var set to valid JSON dict with role 'cio' mapped to persona 'cio'
Tier-2 YAML file exists but does not contain 'cio' mapping
Postgres persona_config table does not contain 'cio' row
steps: Verify no Tier-2 file read occurred
Verify no Tier-3 Postgres query executed
expected_results: Tier-2 and Tier-3 sources not consulted (mock verification)
test_cases.given: a role mapped in the env-JSON source
test_cases.then: it returns the persona from Tier-1 without consulting Tier-2 or Tier-3

test_cases.title: Tier-2 YAML fallback when role not in Tier-1
test_cases.objective: Verify that when a role has no Tier-1 mapping but exists in the Tier-2 YAML config file, the resolver returns the Tier-2 persona without querying Postgres.
preconditions: PERSONA_ROLE_MAP env var empty or role not present in Tier-1
Tier-2 YAML file exists with role 'developer' mapped to persona 'developer'
Postgres persona_config table does not contain 'developer' row
steps: Configure empty PERSONA_ROLE_MAP or omit 'developer' from it
Load Tier-2 YAML with 'developer: developer' mapping
Verify no Tier-3 Postgres query executed
test_cases.given: a role with no env-JSON mapping but a mapping in the config file
test_cases.then: it returns the config-file tier's persona without consulting Tier-3

test_cases.title: Tier-3 Postgres fallback when role not in Tier-1 or Tier-2
test_cases.objective: Verify that when a role has no Tier-1 or Tier-2 mapping but exists in the Postgres persona_config table, the resolver returns the Tier-3 persona.
preconditions: PERSONA_ROLE_MAP env var empty or role not present in Tier-1
Tier-2 YAML does not contain the role
Postgres persona_config table contains row: role='architect', persona='architect'
steps: Verify Tier-3 Postgres query was executed
expected_results: Tier-3 query executed exactly once (mock verification)
test_cases.given: a role with no env-JSON or config-file mapping but a row in Postgres
test_cases.then: it returns the Postgres tier's persona

test_cases.title: All sources empty raises PersonaNotFoundError
test_cases.objective: Verify that when a role has no mapping in any of the three sources, the resolver raises PersonaNotFoundError without returning a default persona.
preconditions: PERSONA_ROLE_MAP env var empty or role not present in Tier-1
Tier-2 YAML does not contain the role
Postgres persona_config table does not contain the role
steps: Ensure Postgres persona_config has no row for 'unmapped_role'
test_cases.given: a role with no mapping in any of the three sources
test_cases.then: it raises PersonaNotFoundError without returning a default

test_cases.title: Warm cache hit returns cached persona without re-reading sources
test_cases.objective: Verify that when a persona is already cached for a role and the cache has not expired, the resolver returns the cached value without consulting any source tier.
preconditions: Role 'product-manager' mapped in Tier-3 to persona 'product-manager'
resolver.resolve('product-manager') already called once (cache populated)
Less than 5 minutes have elapsed since first resolution
steps: Verify no Tier-1/2/3 sources consulted on second call
expected_results: No Tier-3 query executed on second call (mock verification)
persona_mapping_loaded event emitted with cached flag or reused tier
test_cases.given: a resolved persona is already cached for a role
test_cases.when: the resolver is called again within 5 minutes
test_cases.then: the cached value is returned without re-reading sources

test_cases.title: Cache expiry after 5 minutes re-reads sources
test_cases.objective: Verify that when a role's cache entry has expired (5 minutes since last resolution), the next resolve() call re-queries the sources and updates the cache.
preconditions: Role 'engineering-manager' mapped in Tier-3
resolver.resolve('engineering-manager') already called once (cache populated)
More than 5 minutes have elapsed since first resolution
steps: Call resolver.resolve('engineering-manager') - populates cache with expiry timestamp
Verify Tier-3 query executed on second call
expected_results: Cache updated with new expiry timestamp (now + 300s)
test_cases.given: a role-persona mapping is cached but the 5-minute TTL has expired
test_cases.when: the resolver is called again after expiry
test_cases.then: it re-reads the sources and updates the cache

test_cases.title: Data-driven custom role mapping (executive role to cio)
test_cases.objective: Verify that the resolver is fully data-driven and maps any custom role slug (e.g., 'board_member') to 'cio' when such a mapping exists in one of the sources, without hardcoded exec-role logic.
preconditions: Tier-2 YAML contains custom role 'board_member' mapped to persona 'cio'
No hardcoded exec-role list in resolver code
steps: Load Tier-2 YAML with 'board_member: cio' mapping
Verify resolution succeeds without role-specific branching
expected_results: No code path contains hardcoded 'cxo' or 'board_member' checks
test_cases.given: an additional executive role slug is added to a source mapped to cio
test_cases.when: the resolver runs for that role
test_cases.then: it returns cio via data-driven lookup

test_cases.title: Tier-1 unparseable JSON logs warning and treats as empty
test_cases.objective: Verify that when PERSONA_ROLE_MAP contains invalid JSON, the Settings validator logs a warning and treats Tier-1 as empty, falling through to Tier-2/3.
preconditions: PERSONA_ROLE_MAP env var set to invalid JSON (e.g., '{cio: cio}' without quotes)
Tier-3 contains role 'cio' mapped to 'cio'
steps: Verify resolution falls through to Tier-3
expected_results: Settings validator logs warning with masked excerpt
settings.persona_role_map is None or empty dict
test_cases.then: a warning is logged and Tier-1 is treated as empty

test_cases.title: Missing Tier-2 YAML file causes startup error
test_cases.objective: Verify that when the Tier-2 YAML file (services/api/config/persona_role_map.yaml) is missing, PersonaResolver initialization raises FileNotFoundError and the app fails to start.
preconditions: services/api/config/persona_role_map.yaml file does not exist
App is starting (lifespan startup context)
steps: Delete or rename Tier-2 YAML file
Attempt to initialize PersonaResolver in app startup lifespan
expected_results: FileNotFoundError raised with file path in message
test_cases.then: a startup error is raised and the app fails to start

test_cases.title: Malformed Tier-2 YAML causes startup error
test_cases.objective: Verify that when the Tier-2 YAML file contains invalid YAML syntax, PersonaResolver initialization raises yaml.YAMLError and the app fails to start.
preconditions: services/api/config/persona_role_map.yaml contains invalid YAML (e.g., unclosed bracket)
App is starting
steps: Write malformed YAML to Tier-2 file
Attempt to initialize PersonaResolver in app startup lifespan
expected_results: Fatal error logged with YAML parse error details
test_cases.then: a startup error is raised and the app fails to start

test_cases.title: Tier-3 query timeout raises PersonaResolutionError
test_cases.objective: Verify that when a Tier-3 Postgres query exceeds the 3.0s timeout, the resolver raises PersonaResolutionError with a timeout message.
preconditions: Tier-1 and Tier-2 do not contain the role
Postgres persona_config query is mocked to sleep for 4 seconds (exceeds timeout)
steps: Mock Tier-3 query to sleep for 4 seconds
expected_results: Error message contains 'Tier-3 query timeout after 3.0s'
test_cases.then: PersonaResolutionError is raised with timeout message

test_cases.title: Warm cache hit latency <1ms p99
test_cases.objective: Verify that warm cache hits (role already cached, not expired) complete in under 1ms at p99 across 100 iterations.
preconditions: Role 'cio' already resolved and cached
Cache has not expired (within 5-minute TTL)
steps: Measure time.perf_counter() delta for 100 consecutive resolve('cio') calls

budget.measured: p99 < 1ms, assertion passed this run (stdout redirected to file, non-tty — see AF-03)

test_cases.title: Cold Tier-3 hit latency <100ms p95
test_cases.objective: Verify that cold cache misses requiring Tier-3 Postgres lookup complete in under 100ms at p95 across 10 iterations.
preconditions: Cache is empty or expired
Postgres persona_config contains the role
Postgres is running and responsive
steps: Measure time.perf_counter() delta for 10 consecutive resolve('architect') calls with cache cleared between each
expected_results: 10 Tier-3 queries executed (one per cold miss)
test_cases.given: cache is cold and role exists in Tier-3
test_cases.when: resolve() is called 10 times with cleared cache

budget.measured: p95 < 100ms, assertion passed this run against live Postgres (localhost:5443)

test_cases.title: Concurrency: N=10 concurrent requests result in 1 Tier-3 query
test_cases.objective: Verify that when 10 concurrent coroutines request the same role with a cold cache, the asyncio.Lock prevents duplicate Tier-3 queries and only one query is executed.
preconditions: Cache is empty
Tier-1 and Tier-2 do not contain the role
Postgres persona_config contains the role
expected_results: Exactly 1 Tier-3 query executed (asyncio.Lock serialized access)
9 requests hit the cache after the first request populated it
test_cases.given: 10 concurrent requests for the same role with cold cache
test_cases.then: only 1 Tier-3 query is executed due to lock

test_cases.title: persona_mapping_loaded event contains no PII
test_cases.objective: Verify that the persona_mapping_loaded structured log event carries only the allowed fields (role, persona, tier, timestamp) and no user context or PII.
preconditions: Role 'cio' mapped in Tier-1
Log capture enabled
steps: Configure log capture (pytest caplog or mock logger)
Enumerate all fields in the event's extra dict
expected_results: Event contains exactly: role='cio', persona='cio', tier='tier-1-env', timestamp=<iso8601>
JSONFormatter meta fields present: level, logger, message
Event does NOT contain: user_id, email, groups, session_id, programs, or any request context
test_cases.then: event contains only allowed fields with no PII

test_cases.title: Fresh Tier-3 resolution emits tier3_latency_ms
test_cases.objective: Verify a fresh Tier-3 query adds tier3_latency_ms to persona_mapping_loaded and adds nothing else beyond TC-15's allowlist.
preconditions: PersonaResolver constructed with a Tier-2 YAML stub
Cache empty unless a step says otherwise
steps: Configure Tier-1 and Tier-2 to miss the role
expected_results: Key set is exactly TC-15's 7 keys plus tier3_latency_ms — no PII
test_cases.given: the persona_mapping_loaded event schema (FR-5 base + D-11's tier3_latency_ms)
test_cases.when: a persona is resolved from a given tier
test_cases.then: tier3_latency_ms is present only for a fresh Tier-3 query

test_cases.title: Tier-1 and Tier-2 resolutions omit tier3_latency_ms
test_cases.objective: Verify the field is absent when no Tier-3 query ran.
preconditions: PersonaResolver constructed with a Tier-2 YAML stub
Cache empty unless a step says otherwise
steps: Map a role in Tier-1 and another in Tier-2
test_cases.given: the persona_mapping_loaded event schema (FR-5 base + D-11's tier3_latency_ms)
test_cases.when: a persona is resolved from a given tier
test_cases.then: tier3_latency_ms is present only for a fresh Tier-3 query

test_cases.title: Warm hit reusing tier-3-postgres omits tier3_latency_ms
test_cases.objective: Verify a cached Tier-3 value does not re-emit the original measurement, which would dilute the 200ms p95 alert.
preconditions: PersonaResolver constructed with a Tier-2 YAML stub
Cache empty unless a step says otherwise
steps: Resolve the same role again within the TTL
expected_results: Warm event keeps tier == 'tier-3-postgres' but omits tier3_latency_ms
test_cases.given: the persona_mapping_loaded event schema (FR-5 base + D-11's tier3_latency_ms)
test_cases.when: a persona is resolved from a given tier
test_cases.then: tier3_latency_ms is present only for a fresh Tier-3 query
